title: Tableau circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with a binary input alphabet, and let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$. The tableau circuit has $n$ input vertices, the gate list constructed through time $T+1$, and output vertex equal to the tableau vertex for the output bit at time $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine with binary input alphabet
